title: Dashboard Queries
last_note: Implementation complete. Flagged deviation: DashboardStatsServiceImpl catches RuntimeException (not narrowly UpstreamUnavailableException) around userServiceClient.getStats/discoveryServiceClient.getStats/connectionServiceClient.getStats/reportServiceClient.getTopReported, because those four client methods deliberately have NO @CircuitBreaker fallbackMethod (per their own class comments) and so throw the raw exception (CallNotPermittedException/WebClientResponseException/WebClientRequestException/IllegalStateException), never UpstreamUnavailableException -- catching only the narrower type as the ticket's literal wording says would have left 4 of 5 tiles unprotected against real upstream outages. reportServiceClient.getReportsToday() is a new KNOWN GAP method (GET /reports with no query params does not exist on report-service's ReportController yet) mirroring the existing getReportHistory KNOWN GAP precedent; it always degrades via UpstreamUnavailableException until Report Service ships that endpoint in a future ticket, exactly as the ticket itself anticipated.
